messages:
Sage: FYI - premerge SAST on auth-service flagged a high-sev: hardcoded key-like pattern in src/auth/session.go. CI link: https://ci.redwood/example/1234 :eyes:
Priya: thanks. can you paste the file snippet and the scanner finding id? we need to decide triage vs immediate blocker. high sev = 4h SLA for sec response :alarm_clock:
Sage: finding id FND-2026-778, snippet:```go
// TODO temp key for tests
var sessionKey = "abc123-dev"
```
Liam: oh that was me from last-week quick patch for local tests. not used in prod builds but upstream linter still picks it up. I can remove in next patch, ETA ~2h.
Priya: ok if it's not in prod build we can do a short waiver, but we need evidence: show build matrix proving the artifact doesn't include that file and add an audit log entry for the waiver. also record remediation PR.
Marta: quick question - last night staging had a KMS decrypt error when a temporary role was rotated. is there any overlap? I saw an auth deploy that touched iam bindings.
Liam: that was my change, I flipped a service account role to roles/keystore.viewer for the deploy job. It caused ephemeral deployer to fail to decrypt seeding tokens in one run. I reverted after noticing. log: ```Error: AccessDeniedException: Caller does not have kms:Decrypt on projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRING/key```.
Priya: we need two things: 1) RBAC checklist update for premerge deploy perms so CI jobs have explicit least-priv grants, 2) an audit-log play: every temporary grant must have an authorization ticket id in the grant description and a correlating entry in the keystore-audit index.
Sage: propose interim flow: if security triages and accepts waiver (<24h fix window), engineer adds label `security/waiver-short` to PR, opens a ticket in SEC-EXEMPT with the scanner id and artifact proof, and oncall runs ephemeral grant via keystore-bot with `--reason SEC-WAIVER:<ticket>` so it auto-links.
keystore-bot: Granted ephemeral role `keystore.decrypter` to serviceAccount:ci-deployer@redwood for 30m (reason: SEC-WAIVER:SEC-3456) :white_check_mark:
Priya: perfect — also add a line in the PR checklist that links to audit retrieval commands so reviewers can paste the audit query output. example command:
```bash
# find ephemeral grants correlated to ticket
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.requestMetadata.callerSuppliedUserAgent:keystore-bot AND jsonPayload.request.reason:SEC-WAIVER:SEC-3456" --project=infra --limit=50
```
Liam: will do. I'll open the removal PR and attach the CI artifact proving token not baked into release, and request the `security/waiver-short` label if Priya signs off.
Priya: once PR is up I'll triage within 4h. If remediation slips beyond 24h we treat as blocker and schedule emergency rollback. Also flag DAST smoke: run quick login DAST for that PR since auth touched session code.
Sage: noted. thanks all, updating the SDLC checklist doc after this thread and adding a small template for waiver tickets + audit commands. :memo:
Marta: added a brief blurb to eng-runbooks about the ephemeral grant naming convention so ops can grep easily. :thumbsup:
